meta.note: Open-ended base block after the Sept 12 BurliMOT half (1:54:00). Restarted at Week 1 on Oct 1 2026 (first run Thu Oct 1). Four 4-week blocks; every 4th week is a flex week. Ends with a 5K time trial Jan 16 and a check-in on what comes next.

foundation.peakTrainingLoad: ~50-60 mi/week in college; ~25 mi/week peak in 2026

strengths.evidence: Deep collegiate aerobic foundation; fitness returned quickly in 2026 and the half landed on predicted pace.

limiters.evidence: Knee soreness history tied to doing too much too soon; training was interrupted several times this year.

constraints: Knee: conservative volume progression, flex week every 4th week
Holidays: Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's fall in Blocks 3-4
Strength folded into Tue/Fri easy-run days

hr.note: LTHR 171 from June field test — primary guide for easy runs.

pace.note: From 1:54:00 half (≈VDOT 39). Recalibrate after the Week 16 time trial.

zones.name: Easy
zones.description: Fully conversational. Zone 2 HR. ~85% of all running.

zones.name: Steady
zones.description: Block 3-4 steady runs. Comfortable but purposeful, short sentences. Zone 3.

zones.name: Threshold
zones.description: Not used this block — reference only.

zones.name: Strides
zones.description: 20s accelerations, full recovery. Form, not speed.

phases.name: Return
phases.focus: Post-race return; easy only; strength begins

phases.name: Aerobic Base
phases.focus: Build the aerobic engine; strides return

phases.name: Base + Quality

weeks.focus: Restarted Oct 1 — short, easy, run/walk OK · 8 mi

workouts.name: Easy 2 mi
workouts.description:
FIRST RUN of the restarted block. Run/walk is completely fine (4 min run / 1 min walk). Only goal: finish feeling like you could do it again tomorrow.
Knee check: soreness that changes your stride or lingers into the next morning = take the next day off.
workouts.humanReadable:

workouts.name: Strength (after run)
workouts.description: Folded into today's run — do it right after while warm.
workouts.humanReadable:
Knee-insurance strength (15-20 min, right after the run)
2 rounds:
  • Glute bridge x 15
  • Side-lying leg raise x 12 each
  • Clamshell (band) x 15 each
  • Lateral band walk x 12 steps each way
  • Slow step-down (4-6" step) x 8 each leg — knee tracks over 2nd toe
  • Calf raise x 15 (straight knee) + x 15 (bent knee)
  • Plank 30-45s + side plank 20-30s each side

weeks.focus: Thanksgiving week — steady run introduced (on Tuesday) · 23 mi

workouts.name: Steady Run — 20 min steady
workouts.description: One controlled, moderate effort to keep some sharpness while volume builds.
workouts.humanReadable:
Warm-up: 1.5 mi easy
Main: 20 min STEADY @ ~9:00-9:20/mi (Zone 3, HR ~153-160). Comfortable but purposeful — you can talk in short sentences. This is NOT tempo.
Cool-down: easy to finish 6 mi total.

If HR drifts above 160 or the knee complains, back off to easy and call it a normal run.

First steady run of the block. On Tuesday this week because of Thanksgiving — strength moves to Wednesday.

workouts.name: Strength (after run)
workouts.description: Folded into today's run — do it right after while warm.
workouts.humanReadable:
Strength (20 min, right after the run)
Glute/hip warm-up: bridges x 12, lateral band walk x 10 each way
2-3 rounds:
  • Goblet squat x 10
  • Single-leg Romanian deadlift x 8 each
  • Rear-foot-elevated split squat x 8 each
  • Step-up x 10 each
  • Single-leg calf raise x 12 each
  • Push-up x 10-15
  • Dead bug x 10 each + side plank 30s each
Moderate load — finish feeling like you had 2-3 reps left.

2 rounds:
  • Glute bridge x 15
  • Side-lying leg raise x 12 each
  • Clamshell (band) x 15 each
  • Lateral band walk x 12 steps each way
  • Slow step-down (4-6" step) x 8 each leg — knee tracks over 2nd toe
  • Calf raise x 15 (straight knee) + x 15 (bent knee)
  • Plank 30-45s + side plank 20-30s each side

workouts.name: 🏁 5K Time Trial — Benchmark
workouts.description: End-of-block benchmark. Sets your zones for whatever comes next — spring race build or another base block.
workouts.humanReadable:
Flat route or track. Same route you'd repeat in the future if possible.

Warm-up: 1.5 mi easy + 4 x 20s strides
5K: even effort. Mile 1 slightly conservative (~8:00-8:15), mile 2 settle, mile 3 go.
Cool-down: 1.5 mi easy walk/jog

📝 Record: finish time, avg HR, max HR, how the knees felt. Share it and we'll recalibrate everything.
Reference: May 2026 5K was 26:33. The 1:54 half predicts roughly 25:00-25:30 today.
